acceptanceCriteria.text: Reading an FR, TR, TEST or mapping through REST, the typed client or the REPL reports the creation and update times stored with that record. A read never reports the time of the read; when the store holds no time, the value is null (operator 2026-11-02: "This HAS to be fixed."; PR 87 slice P). A stored time written without an offset is read as UTC (operator 2026-11-02: "UTC"; pre-HV what-if finding: no contract row pinned it). A read never fills a missing date from the clock: a stored value without a complete date (a time alone, or a partial date) reads as null and is ignored when a mapping's creation time is chosen (operator 2026-11-02: "Strengthen 5 ACs, fix all 8 (Recommended)"; hostile validation finding R9-F4). A readable stored time states its year, its month and its day as date components: a year and month alone, and year digits that appear only in a time, a fraction or another component, read as null and are ignored when a mapping's creation time is chosen, whatever the read clock says (hostile validation round 10 finding R10-F1; strengthened between rounds under the operator's "Strengthening Acceptance Criteria should always be the recommended option" and "don't gate on me between rounds", 2026-11-03).

result.description:
The server shall support CRUD operations for Functional Requirements (FR), Technical Requirements (TR), Testing Requirements (TEST), and FR-to-TR mapping rows backed by the canonical project requirements Markdown files.

**Covered by:** `RequirementsController`, `RequirementsDocumentService`, `IRequirementsRepository`
